@echo off
echo Restoring Local Network Sharing and TV Casting...
sc config LanmanServer start=auto >nul 2>&1
sc config fdPHost start=demand >nul 2>&1
sc config FDResPub start=auto >nul 2>&1
sc config SessionEnv start=demand >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BcastDVRUserService" /v "Start" /f >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\DevicesFlowUserSvc" /v "Start" /f >nul 2>&1
echo Network discovery restored. Restart your PC.
pause
